poll_note: The feed's metaData.wait asks for 10 s. Measured on 849844 (2026-10-02): a pitch reaches the feed about 11 s after it is thrown, then waits for our next fetch. fast_poll_s applies only while a viewer whose broadcast delay is under fast_poll_below_delay_s is watching (plan CP4).
display_note: PROVISIONAL, not a validated limit. feed_lag_delayed_s: a served snapshot whose newest game event was still missing from a good poll made more than this many seconds after it (the proven minimum lag) puts the fan screen in the feed_delayed display state (display_state.py). 45 is a first guess above the lag seen on one live game (849844, 2026-10-02: median about 19 s); revisit after the replay rehearsal. Env PITCHEEZY_OBSERVER_FEED_LAG_DELAYED_S overrides.
features_note: PROVISIONAL owner switches (observer_app/features.py), not validated settings. ALL OFF by default (owner decision 2026-10-11: the public service publishes one delay-0 body for every fan; per-viewer delay is only for the direct path to this server, turned on with PITCHEEZY_OBSERVER_VIEWER_DELAY=1; with it off ?delay= is ignored everywhere and the other viewer_delay keys are inert). Each block can be turned off without a web rebuild: the fan payload carries the public subset and the screen obeys it. viewer_delay: /api/service/games/{pk}?delay= serves the game as it stood for a viewer whose broadcast runs that far behind (default_s = what an unsynced device starts with; 30 is a first setting from one replayed game, 849831); sync_prompt = ask once to sync on the first open of a live game; fold_actual_until_synced = hide thrown-pitch details on an unsynced device; record_at_receipt = a delayed request also records the newest state's decision in the ledger at once. Env overrides: PITCHEEZY_OBSERVER_VIEWER_DELAY, _VIEWER_DELAY_DEFAULT_S, _VIEWER_SYNC_PROMPT, _PROFILE_REFERENCE, _PROFILE_SOURCES, _STEP5_EXPECTATION, _STEP5_LEDGER, _STEP5_ALLOW_REPLAYED.
zone_bounds_source: League median sz_bot/sz_top of data/raw/d20260911-s2325 statcast_2023-2025 rows with game_date <= 2025-04-30 (bundle training_cutoff), n=1567136. Not batter-specific; the live feed's 2026 strikeZoneTop/Bottom are deliberately ignored.
